Full summary: Implemented Phase 1 of the node-without-npm fix (plugin 1.18.0): new plugin/scripts/launch-server.sh rung-ladder launcher (npx → npm-prefix npx-cli.js → global twining-mcp → stderr diagnostic exit 127, --probe contract line), plugin/.mcp.json now execs it via sh -c with in-script marker-guarded login-PATH recovery (drops -l so profile stdout can't corrupt the JSON-RPC channel), SessionStart hook three-way branch via the same --probe (gates / npm-less-node warning / no-node warning, both warnings carry the TWINING_DISABLED=true commit escape and the false "gates do NOT apply" text is gone everywhere), README + UPGRADE-v2 + CHANGELOG docs, 9 new launcher tests + reworked hook tests. Full suite 1239 passed / 100 files, build clean, exec bit staged 100755. Implemented via ultracode workflow wf_4fe057e9-8e1 (3 impl agents, 2 adversarial verifiers, 1 fixer).
Decisions: Chose to drop -l from the plugin .mcp.json spawn and recover the login PATH inside launch-server.sh via a marker-guarded command substitution — a login shell attaches profile stdout to the MCP JSON-RPC channel, and verification reproduced profile echo corrupting both the protocol stream and the hook's probe parse. Partially supersedes 01KY0QQ1CFDRCVBN0X7GTNT2NY (sh -lc wrapper): the login-PATH rescue intent is preserved, only the mechanism moved in-script where profile stdout is confined and stripped.; Chose a TWINING_LAUNCH_NO_LOGIN_PATH env guard for tests over retry-only-on-failure PATH recovery — macOS /etc/profile path_helper resurrects the real PATH inside any login shell, escaping shim-PATH test sandboxes; the guard keeps tests deterministic and a dedicated regression test still exercises real recovery with a noisy profile.; Chose to collapse the hook's launcher-missing legacy branch into the corrected no-node warning rather than keep the legacy text — it still contained the false 'gates do NOT apply' claim this change exists to fix; the launcher-missing case only occurs in partially-updated installs and the corrected wording is accurate there too.; Chose to shape-validate NODE_VERSION (^v[0-9.]+$ via POSIX case) in the launcher — a noisy version-manager shim printing extra lines would break the one-line --probe contract the hook parses.; Chose NOT to adopt the reviewer's $0-positional quoting hardening for the launcher path (defends against quotes/backticks/$ in the plugin root path) — the path derives from the plugin install location, hostile characters there are far-fetched, and reworking quoting across .mcp.json and the hook after tests went green adds real regression risk for a theoretical case; recorded as decision-not-taken.
